授業概要
都市における地震被害の軽減のために、その都市を襲うであろう地震動を適切に予測し、それに応じた適切な地震防災対策が必要である。そこで、国や多くの自治体では地震ハザードマップを作成し、地震防災対策に努めている。
本講義ではその地震防災対策と過去に発生した被害地震の関係、地震防災対策の歴史と現状について述べる。
In order to reduce earthquake damage in cities, it is necessary to accurately predict the seismic motion that will strike the city and to take appropriate earthquake disaster prevention measures accordingly. For this reason, the national government and many local governments are creating earthquake hazard maps and working on earthquake disaster prevention measures.
This lecture will cover the relationship between these earthquake disaster prevention measures and past damaging earthquakes, as well as the history and current status of earthquake disaster prevention measures.

全体の教育目標
地震および地震防災対策に関する基礎的な知識を習得する。
The goal of this class is to acquire basic knowledge about earthquakes and earthquake disaster prevention measures.
個別の教育目標
(1) 地震に関する基礎的な知識を習得する。
(2) 過去の地震被害を知り、そこから得られる教訓について理解する。
(3) 日本の地震防災対策の変遷や現在の国の地震防災体制について理解する。
(4) 行政による地震被害想定について理解する。
(1) To acquire basic knowledge about earthquakes.
(2) To learn about past earthquake damage and understand the lessons that can be learned from it.
(3) To understand the history of earthquake disaster prevention measures in Japan and the current national earthquake disaster prevention system.
(4) To understand the earthquake damage estimation made by administrative agencies.
